fact: From 2 November 2026 use of the BCEAO PI-SPI platform became mandatory for interoperable e-money transfers between MTN, Orange, Moov and Wave and between bank accounts and e-money wallets in Côte d'Ivoire.
title: Monnaie électronique: les transactions interopérables désormais soumises à la plateforme PI-SPI de la BCEAO
